description: imagepeek: Generate a BlurHash placeholder string for an image. For the palette use image_colors. Returns the BlurHash string of an image (the published woltapp algorithm, identical to the reference package), with `x_components` and `y_components` 1-9 (default 4 x 3), for blurred placeholders while the real image loads. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Images are never logged or stored. Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/blurhash-api.html

auto_orient.description: Apply the EXIF orientation first (default true).
auto_orient.title: Auto Orient

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url

x_components.description: Horizontal components (1-9, default 4): more detail, a longer hash.
x_components.title: X Components

name: image_blurhash

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

title: imagepeek: compute an image's BlurHash
